bakedFrame.axes: x east, y south (plan down-page), z up
bakedFrame.relativeTo: each attachment's own `baked.anchor`, in world metres

source.route: Floorplan Tracer / trace-raster-plan-live (stages B-D); pixel measurement of the 126-grey wall mask, openings from band run-lengths, fixtures read from 4-8x crops
source.calibration: USER's Set Scale on the live underlay (44.6537 px/m = 13.6104 px/ft); cross-checked against 17 printed dimensions, max residual 0.15 ft on every printed room except BATH 1 (see notes)
notes: Wall centrelines are the MEASURED pixel positions, not solved from the printed dimensions: at the user's scale every printed room already reads within 0.19 ft, and the printed set is internally inconsistent (both baths are drawn 65-66 px deep but printed 5' and 6').
BATH 1 prints 10' x 6' but is drawn 9'10" x 4'9" - the 6' does not fit between the drawn faces at any scale. The drawing is followed.
LIVING ROOM / DINING ROOM have no wall between them; the 15'/15' split is authored at the midpoint of the open span.
Exterior walls 8.5 px = 0.190 m, partitions 4.5 px = 0.101 m, both measured off the band faces.
